profile.headline: Siri Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned Mac developer and expert in Objective-C, with some Swift experience. I have a BS and MS in Computer Science, with an emphasis in Software Engineering. I have broad experience in many CS topics, including data structures, operating systems, computer networks, 3D graphics, user interfaces, digital security, languages & compilers, signal & image processing, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

I began programming in elementary school as a hobby, and I have over 30 years of experience with Apple products. I love working in environments dedicated to creating useful, usable, and intuitive software.
